leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct an Angular component that renders static content at build time using server-side generation
Configure an Angular application to enable server-side rendering for dynamic content delivery
Implement data fetching within server-side rendered components to populate templates
Manipulate component rendering strategies by switching between SSR and SSG configurations
Integrate client-side hydration with server-rendered components for interactive functionality
Apply appropriate rendering techniques based on content type and performance requirements
Initialize Angular Universal in a project to enable server-side capabilities
lessonTitle: React Server Components & SSR vs SSG
